terms.definition: The plant tissue that carries food (sugar) made in the leaves to the rest of the plant.
terms.function: Delivers the food plants make to every part that needs it.
terms.whereItIs: Running through the stem, into the leaves and roots and seeds.
terms.whyItMatters: It is how the plant moves the food it makes to the rest of itself.

terms.definition: The movement of sugar food out from the leaves through the phloem.
terms.function: Spreads the plant's food and storage from the leaves to other parts.
terms.whereItIs: Leaving the leaf and traveling through the phloem tubes.
terms.whyItMatters: It makes sure no part of a plant goes hungry even if it has no leaves.

terms.definition: The living cells that make up phloem tubes and help move the food.
terms.function: Work actively to push the food through the plant.
terms.whereItIs: In the phloem tissue of leaves, stems, roots.
terms.whyItMatters: The living cells are what make phloem able to really transport food around.
